New ed. of: Assuring product integrity. 1975.

Sponsored by the American Society for Quality Control, this authoritative book is the first to clearly explain the ways in which the various disciplines within product quality assurance interact to achieve product integrity. It thoroughly examines the two major branches of assurance science and their relationship to design, testing, manufacturing, and application. And it offers both an in-depth treatment of principles--and a valuable overview of quality assurance management approaches and technical tools that provides professionals with a quick working knowledge, without getting bogged down in details.
